evals.prompt: Migrate a walk animation to the ts-sdks API: start idle, play two alternating passes, and restart when an action counter changes.
assertions: Uses one animation object with preset walk
Uses playState idle and playback iterations 2 with alternate true
Uses trigger for the changing counter
Does not use autoPlay or playback.loop

evals.prompt: In the migration checkout, script a left-side punch with 2 damage after 140ms then three victory passes. How do I connect it to the health bars?
assertions: Uses attacker side left and preset punch in a nested attacker object
Uses target damage 2 and delayMs 140 without an explicit target side
Uses victory iterations 3 rather than loops
Reads health and animation from useDuelScript state rather than a second health counter
Imports battle runtime from /battle and types from /types

evals.prompt: I only want a static thumbs-up portrait on my old GitHub archive. Should I wrap it in AnimationProvider and add a custom sequence?
assertions: Routes static appearance to suifrens-display and checks archive generation
Does not require an animation timeline or provider for a static gesture
Notes that head-only portraits ignore the gesture
